list.definition:

FROM part_sheet_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(saved_at) AND machine_id IN (${machine:singlequote})

panels.title: General part sheets
panels.description: General part sheets saved in the selected time range, newest first. Click a part ID to show its history. Station arrays read as one character per station, first station on the left: 1 = true, 0 = false.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    saved_at AS `Saved at`,
    machine_id AS Machine,
    part_id AS `Part ID`,
    data.RefePiecForg AS RefePiecForg,
    data.LotMati AS LotMati,
    data.RefePiecFini AS RefePiecFini,
    data.PiecAnnoChgtRefPiecFini AS PiecAnnoChgtRefPiecFini,
    data.PiecAnnoChgtLotMati AS PiecAnnoChgtLotMati,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x, '1', '0'), data.SuivTravPiecParPost)) AS SuivTravPiecParPost,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x, '1', '0'), data.SuivConfPiecParPost)) AS SuivConfPiecParPost,
    data.QuiDeclNonConf AS QuiDeclNonConf,
    data.QuiDeclConf AS QuiDeclConf,
    data.ProgReceMach AS ProgReceMach,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x, '1', '0'), data.SuivPostAvecPassTrav)) AS SuivPostAvecPassTrav,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x, '1', '0'), data.SuivPrelPiecParPost)) AS SuivPrelPiecParPost,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x, '1', '0'), data.SuivRejePiecParPost)) AS SuivRejePiecParPost,
    data.RefePiecFiniInco AS RefePiecFiniInco,
    data.PiecTravInco AS PiecTravInco,
    data.PiecNonConfAmon AS PiecNonConfAmon,
    data.LotMatiInco AS LotMatiInco,
    data.PiecRebu AS PiecRebu,
    data.DeclRebuMoti AS DeclRebuMoti,
    data.DeclRebuQui AS DeclRebuQui
FROM part_sheet_general
WHERE $__timeFilter(saved_at) AND machine_id IN (${machine:singlequote})
ORDER BY saved_at DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Operation part sheets
panels.description: Operation part sheets saved in the selected time range, newest first. Variables differ between machines: filter on one machine for a readable table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    saved_at AS `Saved at`,
    machine_id AS Machine,
    part_id AS `Part ID`,
    toJSONString(data) AS data
FROM part_sheet_operation
WHERE $__timeFilter(saved_at) AND machine_id IN (${machine:singlequote})
ORDER BY saved_at DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: General part sheet changes
panels.description: Fields whose value changed from one save to the next, regardless of the time range. Station arrays read as one character per station, first station on the left: 1 = true, 0 = false.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    -- Station arrays as "1"/"0" strings, JSON strings unquoted.
    raw -> multiIf(
        match(raw, '^\\[(true|false)(,(true|false))*\\]$'),
        arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x, '1', '0'), JSONExtract(raw, 'Array(Bool)'))),
        startsWith(raw, '"'), JSONExtractString(raw),
        raw
    ) AS display,
    fields AS (
        SELECT saved_at, machine_id, kv.1 AS field, kv.2 AS value
        FROM part_sheet_general
        ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractKeysAndValuesRaw(toJSONString(data)) AS kv
        WHERE part_id = ${part_id:singlequote}
    )
SELECT
    saved_at AS `Saved at`,
    machine_id AS Machine,
    field AS Field,
    display(previous) AS Before,
    display(value) AS After
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        lagInFrame(value) OVER w AS previous,
        row_number() OVER w AS version
    FROM fields
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY field ORDER BY saved_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
WHERE version > 1 AND value != previous
ORDER BY `Saved at` DESC, Field
